judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The 'Damn! Where have you been, lad!?' bark, 'All Nox is now in peril', the mana-depleted captive and the stilted 'At happier other times' and 'leaving rebuilding the village our smallest concern' are Westwood's own clumsy-earnest register; the terse 'Go to [Place] and rescue [Person]' journal line matches too.
